front: What is the core principle and definition of Satellite Circuit Interference?
back: When many satellite circuits (transponders) are used in the same frequency band, the signal from one circuit may interfere with another circuit.

front: What is the core principle and definition of Bent-Pipe Transponder Combined C/N Ratio?
back: Hence, the combined C/N ratio of a bent-pipe transponder satellite link is given by the inverse sum formula.

front: What is the core principle and definition of Output Back-Off (OBO)?
back: Output Back-Off (OBO) is the amount by which the actual operating output power is kept below the saturation power of the amplifier.

front: What is the core principle and definition of Free Space Transmission Loss?
back: Free space transmission loss is the loss in signal power as the electromagnetic wave propagates through space without any physical medium.
